$comment: The chromedriver the app e2e attaches to the CEF desk with (ADR 0144): Chrome for Testing's build for the app's Chromium, by platform, with the SHA-256 of each zip. e2e/support/chromedriver.ts downloads and checks them. chromium follows the cef crate (Cargo.toml) and its cef_version.h; Chrome for Testing has no Linux build of 156.0.8078.88, so linux64 takes the build's latest one there (chromedriver checks the major version only). A CEF bump updates this file in the same change.
